summary.text: Kendon Underwood is serving his third term in the Arkansas House, representing District 16, which includes a portion of Benton County; the member page lists his address as Cave Springs.

paragraphs.text: The legislature lists his occupation as attorney.
For the 95th General Assembly he is vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.
